timeout.stage: No HTTP status was recorded: fetch had not returned response headers before the 8-second AbortSignal deadline.

limitations: The controller observations bracket the timeout and do not sample every instant inside it.
The client record does not expose DNS/TCP/TLS/first-byte timings, so PC/network/load-balancer/origin delay cannot be distinguished here.
No claim of zero public latency or uninterrupted availability is made.

correctedNetworkLoadBalancerLogQuery.interpretation: No entries is not proof the request never reached the load balancer.
